change: Reordered primaries: wide-grip rows emphasize posterior deltoid and rhomboids over lats (per EMG/biomechanics research). Removed Latissimus Dorsi from primary; made mid back (Rhomboids, Upper Traps, Lower Traps) and shoulders (Posterior Deltoid) the primary muscles. Moved Latissimus Dorsi + Rotator Cuff to secondary under Lats bucket. Research source: wide grip rows shift emphasis to posterior deltoid and rhomboids rather than lats.

Added Triceps (Triceps Brachii) as secondary muscle. EMG studies confirm high triceps brachii activation during the follow-through phase of the forehand. The original data omitted this muscle. All other muscles confirmed correct.

Corrected category from 'Bodyweight' to 'Resistance'. Equipment is 'machine' (treadmill), which maps to 'Resistance' category per CLAUDE.md rules (machine=Resistance). Muscle data verified and unchanged.
